title: ticfac Phase 1: the reconciler and the local subprocess executor
description: SPEC §12 Phase 1. Create the separate ticfac repository with its own CI and ticfac run-epic <id>. Implement the tk client, Git integration command, evidence command and the restartable reconciliation loop for one epic at concurrency one — the deterministic lifecycle (claims, waves, gates, merge, boundary checks, cleanup ordering) in code. Implement the local subprocess executor through the four operations: worktree per attempt, runner launched headless, RESULT as completion contract; claude, codex and pi are runner values on this one executor. Profiles resolve to executor, runner, model, prompt only. Deliverables: ticfac repo, reconciler, subprocess executor, three profiles, restart demonstration.
notes: 2026-09-02 13:29 - INHERITED FROM 5hm (properties of the move, not of the old architecture): (1) embedded.go at the module root welds skills + cloud/factory + cloud/sandbox into ONE go:embed unit because go:embed cannot reach above its package; tk factory deploy ships that bundle baked into the binary — that is today's version pin and the hardest structural blocker. (2) cloud/factory/required-tk-commands is DERIVED by a go/ast scan of cloudTkJSON call sites in cmd/tk/cmd; if call sites move the scanner moves with them or is replaced, or the derivation test passes while scanning nothing. (3) cloud/worker is the ticks.sh BOARD, not the factory; it stays. (4) the sandbox image installs two binaries, tk and ticfac, no shim; 'tk cloud ...' becomes 'ticfac ...' and every caller incl. container entrypoints is repointed as part of the move. Also: CHANGELOG 0.32.0 is held UNRELEASED until the extraction settles what ships from where. Prior decoupling work already done under a4n: Phase 1 (3j4) cut the Go dependency, Phase 3 (9hu) split the credential file, Phase 5a (g0b) cut the last cross-repo edges — build on those, do not redo them.
acceptance_criteria: Gate: one real epic on the ticks repository completes through ticfac run-epic locally with a claude or codex runner, killed and restarted after dispatch, after collection and before closure, with no duplicate work and no false success.
